goal: Fixes a race condition in bitcoind's HTTP server that can silently drop a response to a pipelining client
Prevents premature disconnects caused by out-of-order keep-alive state updates between threads
reviewability: Ready to review now: small, self-contained fix with a deterministic regression test
No open questions or mechanical blockers noted
agreement: Concept approval with a stated reason: keeps related state changes in sync under the same lock (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because the bug is real, verified by a reproducing regression test, but the window is narrow
Affects only HTTP clients that pipeline requests, and bitcoin-cli itself does not pipeline
Author explicitly characterizes it as a low-severity fix, limiting practical impact
